images.scene: Setting: the kitchen of a small family restaurant in Brazil in the 1970s, stainless steel counters, big gas stove, white cook jackets. Close, low view of a steel order-ticket spike at the kitchen pass, crammed with a thick messy stack of handwritten paper order tickets, in the foreground and HUGE, reaching the middle of the frame; behind it the cooking line is EMPTY: the big steel stove with pans on it and nobody standing there. The tickets are tiny scribbles, completely ILLEGIBLE. Hard side light from a window. The steel surfaces stretch away and dissolve upward into bright haze; NO shelf, NO hood edge, NO pipe crossing the top.

Setting: the kitchen of a small family restaurant in Brazil in the 1970s, stainless steel counters, big gas stove, white cook jackets. A young line cook in his early twenties, white jacket and apron, ALONE at the big steel stove, a tall flame roaring up from the frying pan in his hand, his face lit by the fire, eyes locked on the pan, shoulders tense; every other station around him is empty, no one else in the kitchen. He stands in the lower half of the frame, whole head visible. CINEMATIC DIRECTION: camera at chest height, one strong directional light source raking across the scene, deep shadows, dramatic contrast. Every person is FULLY inside the frame: heads complete with clear empty space above them, nobody cropped at the neck, shoulders or waist.

Setting: the kitchen of a small family restaurant in Brazil in the 1970s, stainless steel counters, white cook jackets. Seen from CLOSE, inside the kitchen, a few steps behind him: the head chef in a white jacket and tall toque, seen from BEHIND, standing in the open back door smoking, his back turned to the kitchen, LARGE in the frame, his shoulders at the middle of the frame and his toque reaching the upper part of the frame, daylight flooding in through the door around him. Beside him, the edge of the empty cooking line with a pot on the stove, nobody cooking. The doorway is a bright washed-out opening; the wall around it dissolves upward into bright haze with no horizontal edge and no tile line crossing the top.

Setting: the kitchen of a small family restaurant in Brazil in the 1970s, stainless steel counters, big gas stove, white cook jackets. Hard side light. The board's upper part is washed out by strong light so it merges with the bright haze; no visible top edge, no frame line, no shelf crossing the top.

Setting: the kitchen of a small family restaurant in Brazil in the 1970s, stainless steel counters. A single chef's knife standing UPRIGHT, its tip stuck firmly into a scrubbed wooden cutting board on an empty stainless steel counter, the handle pointing straight up, nothing else on the counter. Seen from counter height and close, the knife is TALL in the frame: the tip in the wood sits in the lower part of the frame and the top of the handle reaches ABOVE the middle of the frame, with the whole knife inside the frame and wide margins on both sides. Hard raking side light casting a long sharp shadow across the board. The counter behind stretches away and dissolves into bright haze; NO wall behind, NO shelf, NO counter edge visible.

Setting: the kitchen of a small family restaurant in Brazil in the 1970s, stainless steel counters, big gas stove, white cook jackets.
